skill.name: web-search-scraper-api-skill
skill.description: Extract webpage content as Markdown through the BrowserAct Web Search Scraper API using a provided URL and BrowserAct API key.
skill.summary: Turns a target webpage into Markdown through a hosted BrowserAct scraper workflow.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: Confirmed issues include expected outbound BrowserAct API calls, environment-key access, and one documented Python command invocation. Most Markdown backtick detections are false positives, but the skill also asks users to provide an API key and advertises avoiding verification and geofencing.

remediation.suggestion: Remove instructions that ask users to provide API keys to the agent. Direct users to set BROWSERACT_API_KEY through an environment variable or secret manager only.
Remove claims about avoiding reCAPTCHA, verification challenges, IP restrictions, or geofencing. Add clear permission and site-terms guidance.
Disclose that target URLs and the BrowserAct API credential are sent to api.browseract.com before any request is made.
Show safe argument handling for target_url and warn users not to pass untrusted shell fragments as command text.

content.value_statement: Web research often requires clean text from pages, but manual copying is slow and inconsistent. This skill sends a target URL to BrowserAct and returns extracted Markdown for review or reuse.
actual_capabilities: Runs scripts/web_search_scraper_api.py with a target URL argument.
Reads BROWSERACT_API_KEY from the environment before calling the API.
Starts a BrowserAct workflow using template ID 85961818557645714.
Polls task status and prints timestamped progress messages.
Returns the API result string, usually Markdown page content.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct API key and network access.
Sends the target URL and API credential to BrowserAct.
Can take several minutes while the hosted workflow runs.
Does not verify copyright, site terms, or permission to scrape.

use_cases.title: Capture Article Text
use_cases.description: Extract clean Markdown from public articles for research notes or source review.

use_cases.title: Convert Documentation Pages
use_cases.description: Turn a public documentation page into Markdown for offline reading or indexing.

use_cases.title: Monitor Public Content
use_cases.description: Collect page text from approved URLs so changes can be compared later.

prompt_templates.title: Extract One Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one public page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract Markdown from this public URL: [URL]. Tell me if the page cannot be accessed.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this public documentation page to Markdown and keep headings, lists, and links clear: [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Extracted Content
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract Markdown from [URL], then summarize the main sections and note any missing or unreadable content.

prompt_templates.title: Process Approved URLs
prompt_templates.prompt: For these approved URLs, extract Markdown one at a time, summarize changes, and stop if authentication, paywall, or permission issues appear.

output_examples.output: A Markdown document with the page title, headings, paragraphs, links, and readable article content.
Clean Markdown suitable for notes, search indexing, or follow-up summarization.

output_examples.input: An approved public page used for monitoring.
output_examples.output: Extracted page text that can be compared with a previous capture.

best_practices: Use only URLs you are permitted to access and process.
Store BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the environment, not in chat or shared files.
Review extracted Markdown before publishing, indexing, or quoting it.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or shared logs.
Do not use this skill to bypass paywalls, verification, or geofencing.
Do not scrape private or authenticated pages without explicit permission.

faq.question: What does this skill extract?
faq.answer: It extracts readable webpage content and returns it as Markdown when the BrowserAct workflow succeeds.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY to be available in the environment before the script runs.

faq.question: Where is the page processed?
faq.answer: The script sends the target URL to the BrowserAct API, which runs the hosted extraction workflow.

faq.question: Can it scrape any website?
faq.answer: It can accept HTTP or HTTPS URLs, but users must follow site terms, privacy rules, and access permissions.

faq.question: How long does extraction take?
faq.answer: The script polls for up to five minutes and prints status messages while the hosted task runs.

faq.question: Is the output always complete?
faq.answer: No. Dynamic pages, blocked content, authentication, paywalls, or service errors can reduce or prevent extraction.
